name: Line-based Histogram for 2D Scalar Pairs
definition: A visualization method for displaying the 2D histogram of scalar value pairs (S1, S2) sampled along the gradient direction, using lines instead of point primitives to make material boundaries intuitive.
summary: The Line-based Histogram for 2D Scalar Pairs visualizes scalar value pairs using lines instead of points, mapping bin counts to intensity to intuitively reveal material boundaries in volume rendering.
